0022600148.text: The Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 8th in the East) host the 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) in Charlotte's seventh game of the season, with the Hornets on a two-game losing streak and 2-1 at home. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (quad strain), while Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid, and LeBron James are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
